behavior_boundary.support_authority: runtime-corrective contracts are source, probe, acceptance, report, proof, compile-artifact, and provenance evidence only until a behavior owner split claims the phase
behavior_boundary.generated_report_rule: generated corrective reports, required reports, compile artifacts, replay manifests, proof bundles, module bundles, native-output truth bundles, linked-probe summaries, generated-only rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, and runner-only rows cannot define canonical support
behavior_boundary.retired_surface_rule: retired-route, gate, old-mode, compatibility, unsupported, unresolved dispatch, strict dispatch, sidecar-only proof, unlinked probe proof, replay-text-only proof, catalog-only closeout, generated-evidence-log rows, evidence-log rows, migration-only rows, runner-only rows, and alternate acceptance evidence is canonical rejection, strict-error, absent-support, or provenance-only evidence
behavior_boundary.evidence_boundary_rule: runtime source rows, runtime public ABI/C API path rows, dispatch semantic rows, acceptance workload rows, linked probe rows, native output truth rows, generated report rows, and proof bundle rows remain separately routed evidence classes

runtime_corrective_lowering_provenance_o.support_boundary: lowering provenance binds lowering surfaces to emitted IR/object artifacts, but artifact presence alone cannot create support

runtime_corrective_accessor_owner.support_boundary: synthesized accessor claims require semantic ownership, lowering helper selection, and runtime-backed execution; storage-global retired route claims remain rejection evidence

runtime_corrective_executable_proof_owne.support_boundary: executable proof is e2e/runtime evidence only when compile artifacts and linked probes are coupled; milestone-local harness forks and sidecar-only proof stay rejected

current_corrective_gaps.summary: Unresolved sends still terminate with a strict dispatch error after slow-path miss, so dispatch proof cannot claim universal realized-method execution yet.
Synthesized accessor IR still carries transitional lowering residue even though getter/setter execution already routes through runtime-backed helper entrypoints.
Native-output truth only holds when emitted LLVM IR, object output, compile provenance, registration manifest, and linked runtime probe stay coupled end to end.
